MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
DevOps / Platform Engineering | QA Automation & Test Infrastructure
marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience and a recent focus on CI/CD pipelines, test environments, and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and namespace-level Kubernetes test environments for three product teams. Builds ephemeral environments with Helm and Docker, and has personal hands-on experience with k3s, GitOps, Terraform, and observability tooling. Seeking to move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Infrastructure and delivery: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access; test environments), k3s, Argo CD
Infrastructure as code and cloud: Terraform (personal project), Hetzner VPS (personal), AWS EC2 and S3 (basic, personal learning)
Observability and Linux: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik, cert-manager (TLS), Linux
Scripting and data: Python, Bash, SQL, PostgreSQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Other: Git, Java (test code)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration, and end-to-end test stages and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies, and moving end-to-end tests to on-demand ephemeral environments.
- Built merge-request test environments using Docker Compose and later Helm charts deployed to the company's shared Kubernetes cluster; cluster operations are owned by the platform team.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed test data in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards for flaky-test metrics.
- Wrote the internal guide to how CI works, which is used in onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins jobs for nightly runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023-2024
- Set up short-lived environments for merge requests, with the application, PostgreSQL, and seeded data deployed via Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI.
- Automated environment teardown after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments for feature reviews and end-to-end tests.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Helm, Kubernetes, Docker, Bash, PostgreSQL.

Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal project | 2024-2025
- Ran a three-node k3s cluster on Raspberry Pi 5 devices, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki, plus Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health | 2022
- Profiled pipelines for three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching, and split end-to-end tests into a separate stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30%.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Docker, pytest-xdist.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam preparation; exam scheduled for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. The opportunity to help build the infrastructure connecting a new train fleet with backend services is a compelling fit for the platform-focused work I have taken on alongside QA automation.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. Automating their lifecycle gave teams a place to review features and run end-to-end tests, while my pipeline improvements reduced average run time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30%. I have also documented how our CI works for onboarding and mentored two QA interns, experience that has helped me make technical work easier for others to understand and use.

My infrastructure experience also includes a personal three-node k3s homelab deployed through GitOps, with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik, and cert-manager for TLS. I used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS, and have basic personal learning experience with AWS EC2 and S3. My professional Kubernetes work is scoped to namespace-level access and test environments; the shared cluster itself is operated by a platform team. I am currently preparing for the CKA exam, scheduled for January 2027.

Corvale's work to connect onboard systems with cloud services brings together infrastructure, observability, and reliable delivery in a concrete operational setting. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and improving CI and test infrastructure could contribute to the fleet connectivity work.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
